name: Poison the Well of Life (Quietus, Master) (Assamite)

system.description: You taint a mortal's vitae, turning it into a deadly poison for any other Cainite who drinks from him — useful for guarding a herd against poachers or as a subtle trap for rival vampires. You touch the intended mortal and smear a streak of your own vitae on his skin, then spend three Blood Traits and any number of Physical Traits, rolling a Static Mental Challenge against a difficulty of 7 Traits (retest Occult). For a number of weeks equal to the Physical Traits spent, the mortal's blood is poisonous to any vampire except you: any vampire who drinks from him takes two health levels of aggravated damage per Blood Trait consumed. The mortal gains two Traits when resisting poisons and acids, but also gains the Negative Social Trait Repugnant for the duration.
system.bloodCost: 3 Blood Traits plus any number of Physical Traits
system.duration: Weeks equal to Physical Traits spent
